Market today: Mixed signals. Some tech strength (Akamai) but macro headwinds from rising yields. Geopolitical risks (Iran, Russia) add uncertainty. This environment can be tough on your concentrated, margin-fueled tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.89%) and SPAL (-34.29%) are both in "SELL" status and show significant losses. As leveraged ETFs, their decay and amplified moves are a major concern, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on US Treasury yields – continued increases will pressure growth stocks. Also, monitor geopolitical developments from Iran and Russia for broader market sentiment shifts.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions; the market has conflicting signals that could quickly amplify drawdowns.
plays: Trim SOXL: Consider reducing exposure to SOXL, currently down -34.89% and flagged "SELL." Its leveraged nature makes it extra risky with market uncertainty.
Review SPAL: SPAL is also a "SELL" at -34.29%. Re-evaluate its stop at 21.38 or consider trimming to reduce leveraged exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The market has conflicting signals and your book has significant leveraged risk. Focus on managing existing positions.
